name: Termites
description: Social insects that feed on dead and living plant material. They are particularly damaging to cassava and yam in West Africa, attacking both growing crops and stored products, especially during dry periods.
symptoms: Mud tunnels or sheets on stems and plant bases
Tubers and roots with feeding damage
Earthen mounds visible in and around fields
treatments: Apply chlorpyrifos or imidacloprid to soil at planting
Drench termite mounds with insecticide solution
Use bait stations containing fipronil near active mounds
Remove and destroy severely infested plants
prevention: Remove termite mounds from fields before planting
Incorporate neem cake into soil as repellent
Maintain soil moisture through irrigation and mulching
Remove crop residues that serve as termite food
Plant tolerant or resistant crop varieties
Practice crop rotation with non-preferred crops
